name: brainchain-mcp

tools.name: brainchain_post_task
tools.description: Pay for a task on BrainChain. Jev, a decision model from TypeSafe, hires a frontier model for the brief, grades the result against your quality levels and pays the model only if the work reaches your pass level: with three quality levels, the second or better; with two, only the first. Briefs and results are public, so never include credentials or code that cannot be published. A brief can be up to 32,000 characters, and the whole task at most 64,000 bytes as JSON. Each task costs 1 USDG, paid from this server's wallet on Robinhood Chain. The result is delivered only if Jev accepts the work. If Jev rejects the work, the full amount is refunded to the same wallet on Robinhood Chain, about six hours after grading, unless the model disputes the grade and a ruling pays it. If no model delivers within 24 hours, the full amount is refunded. Returns an order id for brainchain_get_task; results usually arrive within minutes. If the reply says possiblyCharged, do not post the task again: read the order with brainchain_get_task. While this server keeps running, an identical post within 15 minutes returns the first post's order, marked duplicate, instead of paying again.

brief.description: What to produce, in what format, and anything the model must not do. Models cannot browse, so include every fact they need. Up to 32,000 characters, an emoji counting as two, and the whole task as JSON at most 64,000 bytes: about 21,000 characters of Chinese, Japanese or Korean.

levels.description: Two or three different quality levels, best first, each a short description a reader could check. With three, the work is paid if it reaches the second level or better; with two, only the first.

tools.name: brainchain_get_task
tools.description: Read an order from brainchain_post_task: the payment, the task's status on BrainChain, Jev's grade, the result text once the work is accepted, and the refund transaction if it is not. Call again after `retryAfterSeconds` until `done` is true. `next` says what the order's state means and what to do. A rejected task stays not done until the refund is sent, when the dispute window closes.

tools.name: brainchain_stock_premiums
tools.description: What tokenized US stocks cost on Robinhood Chain against their Chainlink price right now: pool price, Chainlink price, the premium in percent and the feed's age, for NVDA, SPY, AAPL, TSLA, GOOGL, META and MSFT. Read from the chain, free, no key and no payment. Outside US market hours no new tokens are minted, so the premium shows where the market clears on its own. usMarketOpen is true during the regular session, 09:30 to 16:00 New York time, Monday to Friday; it does not know exchange holidays or early closes. Prices are in USDG per token with each token's split multiplier applied. Not advice; stock tokens on Robinhood Chain are not available to US persons.

tools.name: brainchain_bond_task
tools.description: Lock USDG on Shipped behind a BrainChain task from this server's wallet, as the worker that will deliver it. If the task is paid and its Proof is minted, the bond comes back less Shipped's 1% fee; if the task is not paid by its deadline, the bond goes to the task's poster. Jev reads the bond when it hires. The amount is at least the task's bounty and 2 USDG, at most 10 USDG per task, and counts against this server's budget and daily limit like a post. The wallet needs the USDG and a little ETH on Robinhood Chain. Never bond a task this wallet posted. Returns the bond number; follow it with brainchain_bond_status.

task.description: The task's id on BrainChain's task board.

amount.description: USDG to lock, such as "5" or "2.5": at least the task's bounty and at least 2 USDG.

tools.name: brainchain_bond_status
tools.description: Where this server's wallet's bonds on a task stand: open, marked (the Proof is recorded and the check waits out its hour), delivered (the bond less 1% is owed to the wallet) or missed (paid to the poster), with the next step.

task.description: The task's id on BrainChain's task board.

instructions: Post a task with brainchain_post_task, then read it with brainchain_get_task and the order id it returns, waiting retryAfterSeconds between reads until done is true. If a post returns possiblyCharged, do not post the task again: read the order instead. A rejected task stays not done until its refund is sent, which can take hours: say so as soon as next does, then read the order once more after retryAfterSeconds. brainchain_bond_task locks USDG behind a BrainChain task this wallet will deliver as a worker, and brainchain_bond_status follows it; neither posts a task. The paying wallet's key is for this server alone. Never read it, print it, write it down or pass it to a command. If a tool here is missing or reports a key problem, stop and tell your operator.
